subject: Every string the library.patches surface exposes to AX in en-US
question: What labels does Logic show on library.patches in en-US, and on which elements?

reverify.expected: a census in en-US whose library.patches rows carry the same 12 distinct strings; a differing set means Logic's labels moved and every provenance citing this record wants re-reading
reverify.cost: ~1 min with Logic open on the fixture project in that locale

method: Read, never actuated. The menu bar and every menu were walked without opening them; the main window was walked to depth 8. Each element with any string became one row of the evidence file; rows were assigned to this surface by what their path or help text passes through, and rows no rule could place are counted in limits rather than filed.

strings: Action pop-up menu. Access patch merging and user default commands.
Delete button. Delete the selected patch or plug-in preset. This action can’t be undone.
Library. Load and save patches, plug-in presets, or Sampler instruments, based on the selected channel strip slot. Loading a patch can affect multiple channel strips.
Revert button. Revert to the saved settings for the patch or plug-in preset. As this erases any changes you made, save with a different name before reverting.
Save button. Save the patch or plug-in preset with its current settings as a new patch or plug-in preset.
Search field. Search for patches and presets by name. Click the magnifying glass to view recent searches or to clear the search history.

conclusion: On this host in en-US, library.patches exposes 27 elements carrying 12 distinct strings. Every string is in the evidence file verbatim, which is what lets a label variant cite this record: the guard requires the string to occur in the observations or evidence, and here it does or it does not.
limits: Navigation-free surfaces only: nothing behind a menu press or a button was opened, so this says nothing about the mixer, plug-in editors or the editors.
134 window rows matched no surface rule and are not filed under any record; they are in the evidence file and can be re-classified when a rule exists.
One project, one host, one build. A label that depends on project content — a track name, a region name — is a reading of this fixture, not of Logic.
